title: The fact table used as a CALCULATE filter filters the dimension through its expanded table
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Products", COUNTROWS ( Product ), "ProductsSold", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Sales ) )

source.quote: the filter context contains all the columns of the expanded version of Sales
source.supports: the article's NumOfProductsSold: a table filter argument filters every column of the expanded table

source.quote: An expanded table contains all the columns of the base table and all the columns of the tables that are linked to the base table through one or more cascading many-to-one or one-to-one relationships
source.supports: expanded Sales includes the columns of Product

derivation: Product has 4 rows. Sales as a filter argument is the expanded Sales table, which includes Product's columns: only products that appear in Sales stay. Sales[ProductKey] holds 1, 2, 3: Scooter (4) is filtered out, 3 rows.
notes: The relationship is single direction: it is table expansion, not cross-filtering, that filters Product here.
